Hi McKay!

I think it's great that you're opting to learn ASL!

I don't know anything that works like DuoLingo for ASL, but the sidebar has some links to resources where you can learn ASL.

I would specifically recommend LifePrint's YouTube channel (found here). I used that myself when I started learning. You're basically watching a one-on-one teaching session between a teacher and a student, and it works really well to learn ASL.

The website of LifePrint itself is also good, especially for looking up words.

The two most important rules of smoking are to be safe and have fun. On being safe: The safest material you can use to smoke out of is almost always glass, but it's not your only option. Besides various fruits and vegetables, some metals are also pretty safe to smoke out of, though if you aren't sure, look it up or just find a better alternative. Try to avoid smoking out of plastic or soda cans, which have a plastic lining on the inside. Again, if you are not 100% certain if something is safe to smoke out of, look it up or just don't do it, it's not worth the damage when you can just put off getting high for later. Now for the fun: Remember that it is easy to fix not being high enough, but it's a lot harder to fix being too high. Start slow, and after you've taken you first hit, wait a few minutes before taking another, this will make sure you're not overwhelmed. My personal preference is to take a good hit, go about my business for 30-45 minutes, then come back and take another. This way I can be high longer, not get so messed up that I can't function, and conserve bud. If you don't know how to inhale, it's super easy. First, take in a deep breath then exhale, this will make sure you don't blow into the bowl and spill stuff everywhere. Then take your tongue and place it against the back of your top row of teeth. That step is optional, but your tongue helps cool the smoke a bit, plus it keeps ash from shooting down your throat. When you take a hit, do it slowly, it's not a competition. When you feel that you've taken a big enough hit (when your lungs are about halfway to three quarters full) pull away and chase the hit by inhaling deeply to make sure your lungs absorb the cannabinoids and terpenes and shit. Then, either exhale through your nose or your mouth. Some people say exhaling through your nose gets you higher, and while I'm not completely sure about that, I find that for new smokers it helps to exhale through the nose if they didn't inhale properly, dunno why but it does. Try to always have a pack of gum or mints around, keep some water and eyedrops too. If you smoke outside you shouldn't worry about your clothes smelling too much, but your breath and your hands generally do, so wash em. That's all for now. Remember to be safe, have fun, and toke on. Cheers!
